'''Galeenia Protector Armor''' was a model of the [[Galeenia Protector Armor|Rodian Protector Armor]], specifically preferred by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]] [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red's]] military forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]] [[Protector (Rin'na)|Protectors]] were easily recognized by their distinctive [[armor/Legends|armor]], which was a modernized version of the traditional [[Chattza clan armor]].
